text: Yes, closing your account doesn't cancel an outstanding advance. You'd still owe the balance, and repayment is typically collected from your linked bank account on your scheduled date. To avoid issues, I'd recommend repaying any outstanding advance before you deactivate, and keeping your linked account funded until it's settled. If you're unsure about your balance or repayment date, check the Albert app or contact our support team to confirm before you close your account.
